description.en: A draggable day–night switch with pixel icons that scatter and a band of light that circles the knob.
description.zh: 拖动开关切换日夜，像素在月亮和太阳之间散开重组，光带绕滑块转动。

keywords: 像素 日夜 开关 日间 夜间 太阳 月亮 主题 粒子 光带 拖动 pixel day night toggle sun moon glow theme switch kaolti

discovery.caveat: 默认切换组件内场景。若要同步宿主主题，可使用 onCheckedChange。可关闭点击声。

source.implementation: LeiBox implementation using DOM, CSS and Canvas 2D with optional synthesized click audio.
source.license: The original design and supplied HTML had no verified redistribution license. The downloadable HTML and framework packages contain the LeiBox reimplementation.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Click or drag the switch. With focus on the switch, press Space or Enter to change modes.
instructions.zh: 点击或拖动开关。键盘聚焦后，可用空格或 Enter 切换。
